_comment: Operator-controlled Product Admin endpoint allowlist for the Product Integration Core (PIC_ENDPOINTS_FILE). Each entry is bound to ONE product and ONE environment; the registry stores only the key (endpoint_ref). Keys are referenced by file and generated by the operator (>= 32 random bytes, base64url). The service key and the delegation key must differ from each other and from every other key.

karryam-staging-remote-example._comment: Future multi-VPS form: TLS 1.3 mTLS to a pinned PRIVATE address; DNS is never consulted. Remove this entry unless the private network and certificates exist.
